notes: Cut-out arcs: an arc whose neighbouring edges happen to converge - the curved slots of a star pattern - was read as a corner fillet and drawn the wrong way round; it now follows the sign in the file unless its ends sit at a fillet's tangent distance from the corner. KO layout lines can be swapped to the other side of the plate (Import Check Layout text tab, NEST right-click, or right-click the line in CONTROL at toolpath time); As drawn puts a swapped line back. The NEST part viewer now shows layout text and lines. The Import Check cut-out and text previews are drawn in place in the 3D views.
